justification: Multi-file refactor: extract shared models, add /full endpoint, simplify frontend route, wire constraint arithmetic into brief. 6 files changed. No DB schema changes, no regulatory data, no user-facing text.

pre_impl.existing_data: Reads dcp_setback_controls and housing_sepp_standards via conveyancing_db functions. No writes.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If DB functions return unexpected shapes, _fetch_constraint_data_from_db catches the exception and returns empty lists — constraint arithmetic runs with available data, gaps reported.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No data mutations. Read-only queries + pure computation. Applies to all requests immediately.

functions.name: _fetch_constraint_data_from_db
functions.input: lga: Optional[str], zone: Optional[str], lot_area_m2: float, lep height and fsr strings
functions.output: tuple of three lists: DCPControl, SEPPStandard, SeppLepOverride — all empty on failure
functions.if_none: Returns ([], [], []) — engine runs without DCP/SEPP data, reports gaps

functions.name: constraint_arithmetic_full
functions.output: ConstraintArithmeticResult pydantic model with realistic GFA, dwellings, binding constraint, steps chain
functions.if_none: If no zone/lga, DB fetch skipped. If lot_area_m2 missing, pydantic 422.

functions.name: run_intelligence_brief
functions.input: IntelligenceBriefRequest with address, lat, lng — constraint wiring at line 2234
functions.output: DevelopmentBrief or RenovationBrief with optional constraint_arithmetic DataField
functions.if_none: If lot_area_m2 <= 0 or computation throws, constraint_result = None, field omitted from brief

values.if_missing: constraint_arithmetic field is None in brief — frontend card falls back to independent fetch

values.guard_at: ConstraintArithmeticCard.tsx:113 — if (briefData) skip fetch, else fetch independently
values.if_missing: Card fetches from /api/constraint-arithmetic as before — backwards compatible

queries.purpose: Fetch DCP setback controls for LGA
queries.if_zero: Returns None — dcp_controls list stays empty, gaps reported
queries.if_wrong: Wrong LGA slug → empty result (no matching rows)

queries.purpose: Fetch SEPP Housing standards for zone
queries.if_zero: Returns [] — sepp_standards empty, no overrides computed
